narrative.intro: Acquisition Logistics is a federal contractor with $609M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Acquisition Logistics received 5 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $122M. Acquisition Logistics obligations are up 131.5% year over year. Acquisition Logistics recorded obligations of $8.4M in FY21, $4.1M in FY22, $6.7M in FY23, $4.1M in FY24, $263M in FY25, and $609M in FY26. Acquisition Logistics has two buying agencies this year, led by the Department of Homeland Security with $598M and the Department of Defense with $10.8M. Acquisition Logistics sells primarily in Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services, which accounts for $609M, and also has work in Other Support Activities for Water Transportation with $311K. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This summary focuses on obligations, agency buyers, and the NAICS markets where Acquisition Logistics is active through FY2026 to date.
